scope: End-to-end legal reconstruction from a booted opening; synthetic deck completion and constrained random outcomes are explicit. Not the original unique hidden shuffle.
normalizations: Perform only the final accepted Cleaver installation and required Mayfly memory trash; exclude source undo/manual moves.

Stop immediately at the winning Send a Message score; omit the source’s post-win free Karunā rez.
hiddenAssignments: Choose Karunā, Whitespace and Funhouse as unrezzed R&D ice.
Choose Manegarm as the unrezzed C15 Server 1 upgrade.
